parameters.name: Comment
parameters.description: The description of the asset group. The description can be up to 500 characters in length.

parameters.name: HostGroupName
parameters.description: The name of the asset group. The name can be up to 128 characters in length.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID of the bastion host where you want to create the asset group.
> You can invoke the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query this parameter.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host instance where you want to create the asset group.
> For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).
